description: This file defines the 'DefinedNames' class, which handles writing defined names, named ranges, and related references to Excel files in XLSX format within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: DefinedNames
classes.description: A class responsible for writing defined names and related ranges into XLSX files, including named ranges, print areas, and autofilter ranges.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the writer with an XMLWriter instance and a Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Main method to write all defined names, named ranges, print areas, and autofilter ranges into the XLSX output.

methods.name: writeNamedRangesAndFormulae
methods.description: Writes all defined named ranges in the spreadsheet.

methods.name: writeDefinedName
methods.description: Writes a single defined name element, handling scope and range formatting.

methods.name: writeNamedRangeForAutofilter
methods.description: Writes a named range for autofilter ranges for a given worksheet.

methods.name: writeNamedRangeForPrintTitles
methods.description: Writes a named range for print titles (rows/columns to repeat) for a spreadsheet.

methods.name: writeNamedRangeForPrintArea
methods.description: Writes a named range for the print area of a worksheet.

methods.name: getDefinedRange
methods.description: Generates the proper range string for a given 'DefinedName' object, considering its internal range expression and worksheet context.
